description: Read this before setting up or changing a Monity dataset: how its steps are written (collect a list, collect one record, next page, open each item, fields and their transforms, how an element is targeted), how to work (look at the page, write, try, read the rows, correct, save), and one example. Monity runs the steps in a real browser; you write them.
name: get_dataset_steps_guide
title: How to write a dataset
